# contemplative-agent-cloud

> Optional managed-LLM backend package for
> [contemplative-agent](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent).
> Installing it, setting a provider and API key, and running the agent
> through its `contemplative-agent-cloud` command (a wrapper around the
> core CLI) routes generation calls in contemplative-agent (distill,
> insight, amend-constitution, post, comment, reply, dialogue)
> through Anthropic Claude or OpenAI GPT. Embeddings, and `run`'s feed
> relevance check, continue to use local Ollama (`nomic-embed-text` for
> embeddings).
>
> The main repository's default stack (Ollama, Gemma 4 E4B by default) is
> unchanged by this package. Cloud routing activates only when this
> package is installed AND an API key and provider are configured AND
> the command is started through the wrapper; jobs installed by
> `install-schedule` call the plain `contemplative-agent` command and
> generate on local Ollama.
>
> Intended for research experiments requiring a generation model
> larger than the local default — for example, comparing how distillation
> behavior changes with Claude Opus or GPT-5 while keeping the rest of
> the memory pipeline identical.
>
> Status: active, maintained by hand by one author (@shimo4228),
> separately from the core.

## Core documentation

- [README](README.md): install, configure, run, security posture, trade-offs
- [End-to-end evidence](evidence/2026-04-21-cloud-backend-end-to-end/README.md): the 2026-04-21 dialogue → distill → amend-constitution run on `claude-sonnet-4-6` and `gpt-4o`
- Main project README: [contemplative-agent README](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent/blob/main/README.md)

## Supported providers

- **Anthropic** — default model `claude-opus-4-7`, credential `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
- **OpenAI** — default model `gpt-5`, credential `OPENAI_API_KEY`

Neither default is verified against the live API; `claude-sonnet-4-6` and `gpt-4o` were, in the 2026-04-21 end-to-end run. The `gpt-5` path may reject `max_tokens` or a non-default `temperature`.

## Architecture

- `src/contemplative_agent_cloud/backends/anthropic.py`: `AnthropicBackend` — implements the `LLMBackend` Protocol against Anthropic's Messages API. `generate()` returns a `BackendResult` (text + `finish_reason` mapped from `stop_reason`, with `max_tokens`→`length`, + token usage). Declares `context_window=200000`, clamps temperature to Anthropic's [0,1] range, and accepts (ignores) `think`. JSON-schema output is requested via a prepended instruction to the user message (Anthropic has no native JSON-schema constrained decoding).
- `src/contemplative_agent_cloud/backends/openai.py`: `OpenAIBackend` — implements `LLMBackend` against OpenAI's Chat Completions API, returning a `BackendResult` (text + native `length` `finish_reason` + token usage incl. `cached_tokens`). Declares a per-model `context_window` by model-id prefix (gpt-5 = 272000, its input cap; gpt-4.1 = 1000000; else 128000), forwards temperature unclamped ([0,2]), and accepts (ignores) `think`. JSON-schema output uses the native `response_format: json_schema, strict: true` mode.
- `src/contemplative_agent_cloud/cli.py`: wrapper entry point. Reads `CONTEMPLATIVE_CLOUD_PROVIDER` / `CONTEMPLATIVE_CLOUD_MODEL` from the environment and from `$MOLTBOOK_HOME/cloud.env` when present (the file overrides the shell), constructs the selected backend (or injects nothing when no provider is set, so the core runs on Ollama), calls `contemplative_agent.core.llm.configure(backend=...)`, then delegates to the main `contemplative-agent` CLI.
- `src/contemplative_agent_cloud/backends/_base.py`: shared retry helper. Transient errors (network, rate limit, 5xx) are retried with exponential backoff; other errors, and transient ones that exhaust their retries, are re-raised so the main repository records them and counts them toward its circuit breaker.

## Security trade-off

Installing this package **relaxes** the main repository's local-only
property (no cloud LLM, no LLM API key). When a cloud
backend is active:

- API keys are loaded from environment variables and sent to the
  provider over HTTPS with every request.
- Prompt content — including episode-derived context wrapped with
  `<untrusted_content>` boundaries by the main repository — is
  transmitted to the provider and may be retained by them.
- Output returns over HTTPS, is passed through the main repository's
  `_sanitize_output()` forbidden-pattern filter, and is stored locally
  in `$MOLTBOOK_HOME`.

Users who need the "No cloud" property (regulatory constraints,
air-gapped deployments, privacy-sensitive assistants) should not
install this package and instead run the main repository alone.

## Related repositories

- [contemplative-agent](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent): the main repository that this package extends (concept DOI [10.5281/zenodo.19212118](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19212118))
- [contemplative-agent-mlx](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent-mlx): the other optional generation backend, local MLX generation on Apple Silicon for interactive use
- [contemplative-agent-otel](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent-otel): turns the agent's replayable audit logs into OpenTelemetry traces
- [contemplative-agent-data](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent-data): memory, constitution and skill snapshots from the agent's runs, CC0
- [shimo4228](https://github.com/shimo4228/shimo4228): the author's hub, listing Contemplative Agent next to the author's other practice lines
